# Zhong WMPF Bridge

This directory vendors the minimal Node bridge from
`netz888/zhong-wechat-wmpf-debugger` for the xzsfbj MVP token handoff.

Only the Node bridge source, Frida address configurations, tests, package lock,
and the upstream GPL-2.0-only license are included. Install the ignored Node
dependencies with `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File
scripts/setup_xzsfbj_wmpf_bridge.ps1` from the repository root.
